about.p1: I'm two years into a System Engineer role, working day to day with Azure infrastructure — network design, IP whitelisting, Terraform-managed environments, disaster recovery. I don't write this as someone who's got it all figured out. Most weeks I'm still looking things up, breaking things in a test environment first, and learning from people on my team who've been doing this a lot longer than I have.
about.p2: Outside work I've been curious about applied AI — not as a buzzword, but as something to actually build with. This site is one result of that: I wanted to see if I could wire AI directly into how a personal blog gets written and published, so posts get drafted with Claude, reviewed through a normal PR, and pushed to LinkedIn by a GitHub Action once they're live. See <projects>/projects</projects> for how it actually works.
about.p3: I write about whatever I'm currently stuck on or excited about on the <log>log</log>. If you're on a similar path — junior, career-changed into tech, or just curious about the same things — I'd genuinely like to hear from you, see <collaborate>/collaborate</collaborate>.

collaborate.title: Let's talk, if any of this sounds familiar.
collaborate.intro: I'm not pitching consulting services here — I'm two years into a junior System Engineer role, still learning most of this. If you're working through similar Azure/AI/DevOps problems, made a similar career change, or just want to compare notes, I'd genuinely like to hear from you.
collaborate.offer1Desc: Working through an Azure or Terraform problem and want to compare notes? I like talking things through out loud — happy to pair or just trade what we've each found.
collaborate.offer2Title: Experimenting with AI in your workflow?
collaborate.offer2Desc: I'm doing the same here — this site's own posting pipeline is the proof. Curious what others are trying and what's actually worked.
collaborate.offer3Title: Career-changed into tech, or thinking about it?
collaborate.offer3Desc: I did that a couple of years ago. Happy to talk about what that was actually like, no sales pitch attached.
